title: Robbery suspect dies in hospital
article: A man hit by a police van while allegedly fleeing a crime scene on a bicycle has died in hospital.
Benoit Aube, 38, who had been in intensive care with head injuries since early Friday morning, died about 10 p.m. Saturday, said nursing co-ordinator Sheila Moffat.
Police released few details about the chase, which is now the subject of a Special Investigation Unit probe.
The chase started around 1:20 a.m. Friday when several police vehicles responded to a report of a theft in progress.
Police vehicles took after Aube and his friend, Eric Albert, 33, as they fled on bicycles.
Aube was hit and pinned under the front left wheel of a police van.
Albert was arrested on charges of possession of buglary tools and breach of probation.
